blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A security policy is a short, clear document. It tells everyone in the company how to behave with information and systems. It covers passwords, devices, email, remote work, third-party tools and visitor access.

Policies are not written to slow anyone down. They are written to stop small mistakes. Most security incidents come from small mistakes — a password used in two places, a laptop used by a family member, a file shared with the wrong person.

Read the policy once. Ask about anything you do not understand. Follow it the same way every day. It takes five minutes and saves the company much more.

items.q: What is a security policy?
items.why: "A security policy is a short, clear document."

items.q: Why are policies written?
items.why: "They are written to stop small mistakes."

items.q: Which is an example of a small mistake from the text?
options: A password used in two places
items.why: "a password used in two places" é um dos exemplos citados.

items.q: The text suggests that most incidents are caused by…
items.why: Inferência: os exemplos são erros humanos simples, não falhas técnicas.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "You should ask when you do not understand."
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz claramente que as políticas não existem para atrasar ninguém.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte falando com um novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team! Before you start, let me walk you through the security policy. It is short, I promise.

You do not have to remember every page. But there are three rules that stop almost every problem I have seen. The first one is simple: your password must not be shared, and it must not be used on any other website. One password, one place.

The second rule is about your laptop. This device is only for you. It must not be used by your family or your friends at home. If it is lost or stolen, call the IT team the same day.

The third rule is about email. If a message looks strange, do not click the link. It should be reported to us first. We will check it for you.

That is really all. Read the policy once today, and ask me anything. Follow these three rules, and you will be fine.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many rules does Charlotte say stop almost every problem?
items.why: "there are three rules that stop almost every problem I have seen."

items.q: What does she say about the password?
options: It must be written on paper
It must not be shared or reused
It must be changed every week
items.why: "your password must not be shared, and it must not be used on any other website."

items.q: What should you do if the laptop is lost or stolen?
options: Call the IT team the same day
items.why: "If it is lost or stolen, call the IT team the same day."

items.q: A strange email suggests that you should…
items.why: Inferência: ela diz para não clicar e reportar primeiro — o e-mail pode ser perigoso.

items.q: How would you describe Charlotte's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela dá as boas-vindas, promete que é rápido e se oferece para ajudar.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please read the security policy on your first day." A security policy is…
options: a set of rules to protect information
items.why: Security policy = política de segurança: as regras para proteger a informação.

items.q: "This laptop is a company device." A device is…
options: a piece of equipment like a phone or laptop
items.why: Device = dispositivo, como um celular ou notebook.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Many people do their job from home now. We call this ___."
items.why: Remote work = trabalho remoto, quando a pessoa trabalha de casa.

items.q: "The company hired a third-party tool to send emails." A third-party is…
items.why: Third-party = terceiro: alguém de fora da empresa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A lost password caused a ___ last month."
items.why: Security incident = incidente de segurança, o problema causado pela senha perdida.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs comuns no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the new policy." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar oficialmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the rules to every office next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar aos poucos, colocar em prática.

items.q: "If an email looks strange, please report it to IT." To report something means to…
options: tell the right people about it
items.why: Report = comunicar, avisar às pessoas certas.

items.q: "Please follow through and change your password today." To follow through means to…
options: do what you agreed to do
items.why: Follow through = ir até o fim, cumprir o combinado.

items.q: "Never log in with someone else's password." To log in means to…
options: enter a system with your account
items.why: Log in = entrar num sistema usando sua conta.
